sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive leadership dominates as Consumer Defensive sustains top-tier rank and high momentum (0.850), while broader market breadth remains entirely absent with 0 of 11 sectors all-green.

Consumer Defensive and Healthcare are leading the market with strong momentum scores of 0.850 and 0.733, positioning them at rank 2 and rank 3, respectively. While Energy maintains the number 1 rank, its momentum is comparatively modest at 0.550. Minor positive rotations are visible in Industrials (momentum 0.417) and Utilities (momentum 0.533), both gaining 1 spot over the last 5 sessions to reach ranks 6 and 8.

Fading segments continue to struggle, led by Basic Materials (momentum 0.200) and Financials (momentum 0.467), which each dropped 1 spot over 5 sessions to sit at ranks 9 and 7. Communication Services remains firmly anchored at the bottom, registering the weakest momentum across all sectors at 0.167 alongside an 11th-place rank.

## Strength
- **Consumer Defensive:** The sole sustained strong sector, holding a top-3 rank across 1-, 3-, and 6-month windows with a high momentum score of 0.850 (rank 2).
- **Healthcare:** Solid high-tier performer holding rank 3 with momentum of 0.733.
- **Energy:** Holds the top overall position at rank 1, supported by a 0.550 momentum score.

## Movers & Momentum
- **5-Day Gainers:** Industrials (+1 spot to rank 6, momentum 0.417) and Utilities (+1 spot to rank 8, momentum 0.533) were the only sectors showing 5-session rank improvement.
- **5-Day Decliners:** Basic Materials (-1 spot to rank 9, momentum 0.200) and Financials (-1 spot to rank 7, momentum 0.467) posted the largest 5-session drops.
- **Momentum Laggards:** Communication Services logged the market-wide low momentum score of 0.167 (rank 11), followed closely by Basic Materials at 0.200.

## Divergences
- **Zero All-Green Breadth:** 0 of 11 groups are positive across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD timeframes, highlighting a complete lack of synchronized market-wide strength.
- **Consumer Cyclical Disconnect:** Consumer Cyclical maintains an elevated momentum score of 0.600 despite languishing at rank 10.
- **Technology Weakness:** Technology sits in the momentum laggards with a sub-0.50 score of 0.483, trailing despite a rank 4 placement.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Market breadth is exceptionally narrow with only 3 of 144 groups all-green, led by sustained strength in Discount Stores and Furnishings, Fixtures & Appliances, while commodities and defensive healthcare face sharp short-term liquidations.

Leadership remains anchored in high-momentum consumer and insurance pockets. Discount Stores (momentum 0.90) and Furnishings, Fixtures & Appliances (momentum 0.89) lead overall strength, with the latter surging +17 spots over the past 5 sessions alongside Engineering & Construction (+17 spots). Diagnostics & Research (momentum 0.80) and Food Distribution (momentum 0.83) are also advancing rapidly, gaining 13 spots each to reach ranks 26 and 16.

Conversely, aggressive fading is hitting defensive and materials groups. Beverages - Wineries & Distilleries plunged 65 spots to rank 103, and Healthcare Plans plummeted 43 spots to rank 60. Meanwhile, metals and alternative energy remain deeply depressed, with Uranium (0.024) and Solar (0.023) anchoring the absolute bottom of momentum rankings.

## Strength
- **All-Green Breadth**: Only 3 of 144 industry groups are positive across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD: Discount Stores (0.90 momentum), Furnishings, Fixtures & Appliances (0.89 momentum), and Conglomerates (0.70 momentum).
- **Sustained Multimonth Leadership**: Top-tier positioning across 1, 3, and 6-month horizons is concentrated in REIT - Hotel & Motel (momentum 0.87, rank 4), Insurance - Reinsurance (momentum 0.87, rank 9), Lodging (momentum 0.86, rank 11), Discount Stores, Furnishings, Fixtures & Appliances, Security & Protection Services, Medical Distribution, and Insurance - Property & Casualty.
- **Top Absolute Momentum**: Discount Stores (0.896) and Furnishings, Fixtures & Appliances (0.894) stand as the two strongest momentum leaders across all tracked industries.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Rapid Short-Term Gainers**: Engineering & Construction (+17 spots to rank 66) and Furnishings, Fixtures & Appliances (+17 spots to rank 33) posted the largest 5-day gains, followed closely by Conglomerates (+16 to rank 55) and Scientific & Technical Instruments (+16 to rank 16).
- **Severe Short-Term Drawdowns**: Beverages - Wineries & Distilleries collapsed -65 spots to rank 103 (momentum 0.43), Healthcare Plans dropped -43 spots to rank 60 (momentum 0.33), and Chemicals dropped -22 spots to rank 40 (momentum 0.40).
- **Persistent Momentum Laggards**: Solar (0.023 momentum, rank 143), Uranium (0.024 momentum, rank 142), Other Precious Metals & Mining (0.041 momentum, rank 140), and Gambling (0.051 momentum, rank 144) remain heavily entrenched at the bottom.

## Divergences
- **Fading High-Momentum Leaders**: Several historically strong groups are losing short-term traction, led by Medical Care Facilities (0.69 momentum, -9 spots in 5 sessions), Luxury Goods (0.60 momentum, -8 spots), and Medical Distribution (0.78 momentum, -5 spots).
- **Emerging Low-Momentum Turnarounds**: Tech hardware and select industrials are logging sharp 5-day rank surges ahead of momentum confirmation, including Electronic Components (+15 spots, 0.50 momentum), Apparel Retail (+13 spots, 0.48 momentum), and Semiconductors (+13 spots, 0.44 momentum).
